name: client-wallet-payment-refund-wlt-boundary
executionConcern: client wallet, ledger, funding, payment and refund ownership at the WLT boundary
objective: Keep every client financial readback WLT-owned, actor/context isolated, retry-safe and explicit when an external result is unresolved.
truthOwner: WLT owns wallet, ledger, payment and refund truth; DSH is a bounded authenticated facade/orchestrator and app-client is presentation only.

tasks.objective: Close own-wallet and ledger isolation through DSH/WLT
tasks.currentProblem: Static wallet UI does not prove server-derived actor/context scope, WLT outage behavior or absence of local balance derivation.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace MySpace/client finance through the shared WLT adapter and DSH representative-finance facade into WLT wallet/ledger repositories; correct scope, permissions, cache/readback and error mapping at the owner.
tasks.targetState: The authenticated client reads only its own WLT wallet/ledger; values equal WLT readback and unavailable/forbidden states fail closed.
tasks.action: Fix WLT repository/handler isolation first, DSH facade second, client rendering last.
mustNotChange: Do not accept arbitrary actor/context selection from app-client.
Do not derive wallet values from DSH operational summaries.
Do not let the mobile client call internal WLT financial routes directly.
Do not create balance or ledger truth in DSH/frontend.
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-actor/context reads are denied or hidden.
Displayed wallet/ledger values equal WLT readback.
WLT unavailable is explicit and recoverable.
No parallel balance/ledger mutation path exists.
tasks.rollback: Revert or roll forward at WLT while preserving canonical audit/ledger evidence; never restore parallel financial truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: WLT read owner plus exact DSH/client bindings for the same client readback.

tasks.objective: Close client funding and order-payment evidence with one authoritative result
tasks.currentProblem: A client-visible funding/payment state can diverge from provider evidence, idempotency or WLT payment allocation under timeout/retry.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace funding/payment intent through WLT provider, ledger, payment-allocation and persistence plus the DSH checkout handoff; correct authoritative evidence, replay identity, allocation conservation, correlation and unresolved-result handling.
tasks.targetState: A logical funding/payment effect is recorded once by WLT from authoritative evidence; repeated inputs converge and unresolved external outcomes remain pending reconciliation.
tasks.action: Fix WLT owner first, then the exact DSH checkout handoff and client projection; use control-panel finance only for the same reconciliation path.
mustNotChange: Do not accept client-declared financial success as truth.
Do not retry an unresolved external effect through another path before reconciliation.
Do not create duplicate payment components.
Do not move WLT truth into DSH.
acceptanceCriteria: Repeated equivalent events converge to one WLT effect.
Payment allocation conserves the governed total.
Unresolved provider result remains explicit until reconciled.
tasks.rollback: Revert or roll forward at WLT while preserving canonical audit/ledger evidence; never restore parallel financial truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: WLT payment/funding owner plus exact DSH/client projection changes.

tasks.objective: Close refund/reversal source routing and canonical readback
tasks.currentProblem: Refund/reversal may be shown as complete before original-source routing and authoritative WLT/provider state are settled, especially after retry or timeout.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace refund/reversal from DSH order consequence into WLT payment/refund/ledger/provider persistence; enforce original-source policy, idempotency/correlation, reconciliation and canonical client readback.
tasks.targetState: One eligible refund/reversal has one WLT-owned result to the allowed source; retries converge and unresolved external status stays pending reconciliation.
tasks.action: Repair WLT refund/provider/ledger owner first, then DSH reference handoff and client/control readback for this exact case.
mustNotChange: Do not silently change refund destination from the authoritative policy.
Do not duplicate a refund after an unresolved prior result.
Do not mark refunded from a DSH-only flag.
Do not mutate historical ledger evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Unresolved external result remains pending reconciliation.
Client status equals WLT readback after restart.
Operator reconciliation is auditable and cannot directly edit balances.
tasks.rollback: Revert or roll forward at WLT while preserving canonical audit/ledger evidence; never restore parallel financial truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One refund/reconciliation owner boundary with only directly affected consumers.
